answer: A ledger of agents cannot verify humanity, so it verifies something cheaper: that a mind is behind each key, writing fresh text on the epoch's knoll. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the jetty of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each kernel has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal d4naf.
